models.title: Directional train throughput
models.modelBoundary: Fixed useful payload and departure rate, excluding peak arrivals and empty returns
models.measurementChain: yard departure timestamps and cargo weighing records

models.title: Gradient traction force
models.modelBoundary: The whole consist occupies one small gradient; only longitudinal gravity is included
models.measurementChain: synthetic gradient profile and wagon mass list

models.title: Speed and tractive power
models.modelBoundary: Wheel force and speed are simultaneous; only mechanical power is counted
models.measurementChain: simulated wheel force and synchronous speed signal

models.title: Freight braking distance
models.modelBoundary: Constant speed during delay followed by constant deceleration, without gradient or adhesion variation
models.measurementChain: synthetic brake-command, speed and deceleration traces

models.title: Cargo clearance margin
models.modelBoundary: Scalar vertical envelopes on one datum, excluding lateral envelopes and uncertainty reserve
models.measurementChain: cargo-profile scans and dynamic-envelope samples

models.title: Block occupation time
models.modelBoundary: Fixed speed, known train length and fixed release allowance
models.measurementChain: synthetic front and rear passage timestamps

models.title: Rolling-resistance energy
models.modelBoundary: Constant resistance over a stated distance, excluding acceleration and gradient energy
models.measurementChain: model force gauge and distance integration record

models.title: Port dwell inventory
models.modelBoundary: Steady mean arrival rate without growing inventory; peak queues are not predicted
models.measurementChain: yard entry-exit event records and inventory counts

models.title: Train noise-energy comparison
models.modelBoundary: Equal sound exposure per event with additive energy, excluding differences among trains
models.measurementChain: fixed-position sound-exposure meter and event counter

models.title: Tunnel ventilation scale
models.modelBoundary: Uniform mean velocity across effective area, excluding transient piston effects
models.measurementChain: multi-point anemometers and section measurements

models.title: Circular-curve acceleration
models.modelBoundary: Uniform circular motion at fixed radius, without cant compensation
models.measurementChain: synthetic speed sensor and alignment curvature data

models.title: Curve versine estimate
models.modelBoundary: Short-chord approximation with chord length much smaller than radius
models.measurementChain: fixed-chord straightedge and midpoint displacement gauge

models.title: Transition curvature rate
models.modelBoundary: Curvature varies linearly along transition length
models.measurementChain: curvature samples and baseline on common chainage

models.title: Lateral jerk estimate
models.modelBoundary: Clothoid at constant speed, excluding cant and body roll
models.measurementChain: synthetic lateral-acceleration trace and timebase

models.title: Vertical grade rise
models.modelBoundary: Constant small gradient with horizontal distance
models.measurementChain: levelling staff and horizontal-distance data

models.title: Vertical-curve acceleration
models.modelBoundary: Constant-speed circular vertical curve; geometric acceleration magnitude only
models.measurementChain: synthetic vertical accelerometer and vertical curvature

models.title: Grade-transition length
models.modelBoundary: Small-gradient circular vertical-curve approximation
models.measurementChain: endpoint grades and chainage table

models.title: Plan deflection accumulation
models.modelBoundary: Arc-length definition for a constant-radius circular arc
models.measurementChain: total-station tangent directions and chainage

models.title: Chainage-error projection
models.modelBoundary: First-order error projection at fixed local gradient
models.measurementChain: synchronized chainage markers and level observations

models.title: Alignment uncertainty combination
models.modelBoundary: Two zero-mean independent orthogonal errors, excluding shared bias
models.measurementChain: independent survey-network closure observations

models.title: Equilibrium cant calculation
models.modelBoundary: Small-angle rigid-body balance using the stated effective gauge
models.measurementChain: cant level, radius and synchronized speed record

models.title: Cant-deficiency calculation
models.modelBoundary: Equilibrium and actual cant use the same effective gauge
models.measurementChain: speed groups and cant profiles at matching chainage

models.title: Cant-excess calculation
models.modelBoundary: Low-speed equilibrium cant is independently calculated; suspension is excluded
models.measurementChain: low-speed passage records and cant level

models.title: Unbalanced lateral acceleration
models.modelBoundary: Small-angle approximation with cant deficiency in metres
models.measurementChain: lateral accelerometer in track-plane coordinates

models.title: Cant-ramp gradient
models.modelBoundary: Linear cant ramp without local steps
models.measurementChain: equally spaced level measurements of both rails

models.title: Temporal cant rate
models.modelBoundary: Constant speed through a linear cant ramp
models.measurementChain: speed sensor and synchronized rail levels

models.title: Deficiency change rate
models.modelBoundary: Deficiency changes linearly with distance at fixed speed
models.measurementChain: curvature, cant and speed on common chainage

models.title: Equilibrium-speed inversion
models.modelBoundary: Small-angle static balance, not an allowed operating speed
models.measurementChain: radius measurement and measured cant

models.title: Mixed-traffic squared speed
models.modelBoundary: Two fixed speed groups with weights summing to one
models.measurementChain: train counts and grouped speed records

models.title: Cant measurement uncertainty
models.modelBoundary: Independent rail errors, excluding common zero bias
models.measurementChain: levelling readings with left-right reversal

models.title: Foundation mean pressure
models.modelBoundary: Known effective bearing area; mean pressure only
models.measurementChain: model load cell and contact imprint

models.title: Foundation concrete volume
models.modelBoundary: Prismatic rectangular volume before deducting embedded objects and recesses
models.measurementChain: length, width and thickness measurements with a volume ledger

models.title: Uniform cooling contraction
models.modelBoundary: Uniform cooling without mechanical restraint
models.measurementChain: embedded slab thermometers and endpoint movement

models.title: Restrained thermal stress
models.modelBoundary: Constant modulus and assumed restraint factor, excluding creep and cracking
models.measurementChain: temperature-compensated strain gauges and multiple temperatures

models.title: Drying shrinkage displacement
models.modelBoundary: Given uniform drying strain without restraint
models.measurementChain: constant-temperature length comparator and moisture records

models.title: Curing sensible-heat budget
models.modelBoundary: Constant heat capacity and uniform temperature change, excluding hydration heat
models.measurementChain: core-surface temperatures and material mass

models.title: Drainage crossfall drop
models.modelBoundary: Planar crossfall excluding local depressions
models.measurementChain: gridded level points and drainage low-point map

models.title: Foundation compression
models.modelBoundary: Lumped linear support excluding plastic compaction
models.measurementChain: model load cell and displacement gauge

models.title: Level adjustment reserve
models.modelBoundary: Three quantities share one direction and datum
models.measurementChain: as-built level table and settlement monitoring

models.title: Specimen mean strength
models.modelBoundary: Equal-weight mean of three specimens, not characteristic strength
models.measurementChain: test-machine load and specimen dimensions

models.title: Translation-error magnitude
models.modelBoundary: Two-dimensional Euclidean distance excluding datum error
models.measurementChain: total-station coordinates on one datum

models.title: Slab yaw from endpoint offsets
models.modelBoundary: Small-angle rigid yaw excluding slab bending
models.measurementChain: lateral coordinates of front and rear slab prisms

models.title: Slab pitch estimate
models.modelBoundary: Small-angle pitch after subtracting design gradient
models.measurementChain: endpoint levelling and design elevations

models.title: Adjustment screw displacement
models.modelBoundary: Ideal thread pitch without backlash or elastic recovery
models.measurementChain: screw-angle marks and displacement gauge

models.title: Station angle projection
models.modelBoundary: Small-angle transverse projection excluding range error
models.measurementChain: total-station angle and sight distance

models.title: Prism-constant bias
models.modelBoundary: One fixed range bias with sign defined by calibration
models.measurementChain: baseline measurement and prism interchange

models.title: Levelling closure allocation
models.modelBoundary: Length-weighted allocation after excluding blunders
models.measurementChain: forward-back levelling closure and segment distances

models.title: Three-point elevation mean
models.modelBoundary: Equal-weight independent observations without shared bias
models.measurementChain: three independent slab elevation points

models.title: Adjacent slab joint step
models.modelBoundary: Two joint endpoints on one common datum
models.measurementChain: readings on both sides of the joint in one levelling run

models.title: Repeated-survey mean uncertainty
models.modelBoundary: Independent identically distributed random errors without autocorrelation
models.measurementChain: repeat observations from independent stations

models.title: Free rail expansion
models.modelBoundary: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted
models.measurementChain: model-bar endpoint displacement gauges, gauge length and distributed temperature records

models.title: Fully restrained thermal stress
models.modelBoundary: A fully axially restrained elastic bar; the result is stress magnitude, compressive for heating and tensile for cooling
models.measurementChain: synthetic restraint force, area, compensated strain and rail-temperature histories

models.title: Thermal axial-force conversion
models.modelBoundary: Stress is uniform over the effective section; force is for one rail only
models.measurementChain: model section dimensions, worn area and axial strain at multiple locations

models.title: Rail-temperature error propagation
models.modelBoundary: Only rail-temperature error is propagated; modulus, expansion coefficient and restraint are treated as known
models.measurementChain: paired synchronous thermometers, calibration records and synthetic stress estimates

models.title: Fastening resistance accumulation
models.modelBoundary: Uniform longitudinal resistance is fully mobilized along the length; it is not pre-slip elastic stiffness
models.measurementChain: segment-by-segment model slip and corresponding longitudinal reactions

models.title: Temperature-equivalent displacement
models.modelBoundary: Free thermal movement over a known gauge length; it is not actual movement of a restrained rail
models.measurementChain: fixed reference markers, model gauge length and mean bar temperature

models.title: Neutral-temperature difference inversion
models.modelBoundary: Strain is an isolated thermal-equivalent magnitude; inversion yields a temperature-difference magnitude, not neutral temperature by itself
models.measurementChain: synthetic strain with known restraint, independent temperature and thermal-drift zero records

models.title: Cross-section temperature curvature
models.modelBoundary: Linear temperature difference through rail height, uniform material and free bending; axial and bending restraints are omitted
models.measurementChain: paired model head-foot temperatures and measured curvature profile

models.title: Elastic release displacement
models.modelBoundary: A uniform elastic bar with constant area; displacement excludes support slip, plasticity and cracking
models.measurementChain: low-load model force gauge, relative endpoint displacement and unloading recovery

models.title: Broken-rail gap scale
models.modelBoundary: Length is the total effective released length on both sides of a gap; distributed friction and fracture dynamics are omitted
models.measurementChain: synthetic gap-displacement profile, temperature difference and declared effective lengths on both sides

models.title: Resistance-heat integration
models.modelBoundary: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted
models.measurementChain: synthetic high-rate current and voltage signals, synchronized intervals and energy integration

models.title: Electrical power cross-check
models.modelBoundary: Voltage spans only the joint and is synchronous with current; cable and source losses are excluded
models.measurementChain: four-terminal voltage, current and sensing-point diagram for a low-voltage equivalent specimen

models.title: Mean upset pressure
models.modelBoundary: Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution
models.measurementChain: synthetic axial force, contact area and joint-alignment offset

models.title: Upset-work estimate
models.modelBoundary: Mean force is constant over effective joint travel; frame elastic movement is excluded
models.measurementChain: synthetic force-displacement curve, frame recovery and relative joint travel

models.title: Heat-affected-zone sensible heat
models.modelBoundary: Region mass, heat capacity and temperature rise are uniform; latent heat, heat loss and temperature dependence are excluded
models.measurementChain: synthetic distributed temperature traces, region-mass estimate and heat-capacity data

models.title: Average cooling rate
models.modelBoundary: Only endpoint-average cooling is calculated; intermediate peak rates cannot be inferred
models.measurementChain: continuous temperature history and endpoint readings at the same location

models.title: Weld vertical angular mismatch
models.modelBoundary: Height difference over gauge length is a small-angle approximation; profiles use one datum
models.measurementChain: multiple straightedge lengths, continuous longitudinal profile and zero calibration

models.title: Section-eccentricity bending moment
models.modelBoundary: Force and perpendicular eccentricity are simultaneous; beam-column second-order effects are omitted
models.measurementChain: synthetic axial force, section centroid and load-line offset

models.title: Relative hardness difference
models.modelBoundary: Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life
models.measurementChain: indentation-hardness grid at equal load, position records and repeat tests

models.title: Inspection coverage fraction
models.modelBoundary: Coverage and total length describe the same geometry; sensitivity and detection probability are excluded
models.measurementChain: calibration blocks, probe pose and actual beam-coverage map

models.title: Joint metal mass
models.modelBoundary: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded
models.measurementChain: three-dimensional joint-model volume, density data and independent weighing

models.title: Joint sensible-heat scale
models.modelBoundary: Given metal mass, constant heat capacity and uniform temperature rise; phase-change latent heat is separate
models.measurementChain: synthetic metal-temperature history, effective mass and heat-capacity records

models.title: Solidification latent-heat account
models.modelBoundary: The specified mass completes the same phase change; latent heat is constant
models.measurementChain: synthetic cooling trace, transformed fraction and heat balance

models.title: Volume-shrinkage estimate
models.modelBoundary: Volumetric shrinkage fraction is an explicit bulk assumption; the result does not locate shrinkage voids
models.measurementChain: model before-after volumes, internal-defect images and feeding-path diagram

models.title: Linear thermal contraction
models.modelBoundary: Only free solid-state contraction after solidification is included; solidification volume shrinkage is excluded
models.measurementChain: cooling temperature and endpoint dimensional change over the same gauge length

models.title: Equivalent conductive heat flux
models.modelBoundary: One-dimensional flow with constant conductivity and an instantaneous linear gradient; not a full transient cooling solution
models.measurementChain: model distributed temperature, sensing-point distances and independent heat-flux estimate

models.title: Void area fraction
models.modelBoundary: Numerator and denominator use one section; a three-dimensional volume fraction is not directly inferred
models.measurementChain: section images in several orientations, pixel calibration and void-segmentation records

models.title: Effective-section stress
models.modelBoundary: Only axial net-section average stress is included; defect-tip stress concentration is excluded
models.measurementChain: synthetic load, defect geometry on the same section and surrounding strain

models.title: Weld crown profile slope
models.modelBoundary: Height difference is small relative to transition length; the result is geometric slope rather than wheel impact force
models.measurementChain: continuous profile scan, gauge length and repeat-scan registration error

models.title: Inspection scan spacing
models.modelBoundary: Speed and sampling rate are constant and synchronized; beam width and missed acquisitions are excluded
models.measurementChain: encoder positions, individual timestamps and actual acquired point counts

models.title: Tamping cycle productivity
models.modelBoundary: Fixed units per cycle and no downtime; ideal continuous throughput only
models.measurementChain: synthetic cycle start-end times, sleeper counts and downtime records

models.title: Under-sleeper void volume
models.modelBoundary: Gap is represented by its area-average value; local voids and particle arrangement are not resolved
models.measurementChain: transparent granular model, contact imprints and gap thickness at multiple points

models.title: Mean squeeze contact pressure
models.modelBoundary: Nominal area is known and resultant force quasistatic; particle point-contact stresses are not represented
models.measurementChain: low-load model force gauge, contact-imprint area and before-after particle grading

models.title: Model squeeze work
models.modelBoundary: Force is the representative average over travel; only external mechanical work is included
models.measurementChain: synchronized model force-displacement samples and loop integration

models.title: Vibration cycle count
models.modelBoundary: Frequency is constant without interruption; cycle count does not establish filling quality
models.measurementChain: synthetic vibration history, zero-crossing count and independent filling displacement

models.title: Lift allocation
models.modelBoundary: Target and existing elevations share a fixed datum; later settlement is excluded
models.measurementChain: fixed model benchmarks, before-after elevations and datum stability

models.title: Post-correction settlement ratio
models.modelBoundary: Settlement and lift share a datum and a specified observation period
models.measurementChain: periodic elevations, model loading cycles and cumulative traffic-tonnage account

models.title: Ballast lateral drainage scale
models.modelBoundary: Saturated steady Darcy flow with constant permeability and hydraulic gradient
models.measurementChain: low-head permeameter model, inlet-outlet heads and timed discharge volume

models.title: Support stiffness recovery
models.modelBoundary: Force and displacement from one origin give secant stiffness, not nonlinear tangent stiffness
models.measurementChain: model multilevel loading-unloading curves and residual displacement

models.title: Geometry residual RMS
models.modelBoundary: Three equally weighted points share a datum; unmeasured regions and local maxima require separate checks
models.measurementChain: pointwise chainage, elevation residuals and sensor-zero records

models.title: Cleaning mass conservation
models.modelBoundary: All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change
models.measurementChain: synchronized stream weighing, moisture correction and machine inventory reconciliation

models.title: Reusable material fraction
models.modelBoundary: Reusable mass has passed separate property checks; the ratio is not a probability of acceptance
models.measurementChain: dry-mass weighing and batch-matched particle-shape and strength tests

models.title: Fresh ballast requirement
models.modelBoundary: Demand is at least qualified recovery and both are dry mass; surplus recovery is separate inventory
models.measurementChain: required material quantity, qualified recovered batch IDs and dry-mass account

models.title: Moisture dry-mass conversion
models.modelBoundary: Moisture is water mass divided by dry-solid mass; sampled moisture is representative
models.measurementChain: wet mass and constant dry mass from one batch plus balance calibration

models.title: Sieve passing fraction
models.modelBoundary: Passing and sample amounts are dry masses from one batch; only one sieve class is represented
models.measurementChain: initial sample mass, mass retained on each sieve and mass-closure residual

models.title: Bulk-volume conversion
models.modelBoundary: Bulk density applies to the same moisture and packing state; solid-rock density is not used
models.measurementChain: known-volume container, batch weighing and packing-state images

models.title: Screening throughput
models.modelBoundary: Mass and time window agree; state whether waiting and maintenance are included
models.measurementChain: continuous belt-scale readings, start-end timestamps and equipment-state log

models.title: New fines from breakage
models.modelBoundary: Before-after samples share a batch and sieve boundary; no external fines are added
models.measurementChain: paired dry-mass grading distributions and sample locations

models.title: Permeability flow comparison
models.modelBoundary: Saturated steady Darcy flow without side leakage; the result is specimen-equivalent permeability
models.measurementChain: stable head history, specimen area and timed discharge volume

models.title: Unrecovered material fraction
models.modelBoundary: Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause
models.measurementChain: calibration at each scale, retained container material and inventory count

models.title: Pad compression stiffness
models.modelBoundary: Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate
models.measurementChain: low-load model stepwise force-displacement, preload origin and unloading recovery

models.title: Parallel support stiffness
models.modelBoundary: Both supports stay in contact with identical displacement; each component is linearly elastic
models.measurementChain: common displacement, separate support forces and initial gaps

models.title: Series support stiffness
models.modelBoundary: Both components carry the same force; no bypass support or slip is present
models.measurementChain: individual layer displacement, common force and total-displacement closure

models.title: Clamping mean pressure
models.modelBoundary: Contact area and clamp resultant are known; local edge peaks are omitted
models.measurementChain: model clamp force, pressure-sensitive imprint and eccentricity

models.title: Clip elastic energy
models.modelBoundary: An initially unloaded linear spring with recoverable deformation; plasticity and frictional loss are excluded
models.measurementChain: model loading-unloading curves, residual deformation and energy integration

models.title: Lateral shear displacement
models.modelBoundary: Lateral lumped stiffness is used with maintained contact; vertical stiffness is not substituted
models.measurementChain: model lateral force, relative slip and gauge-direction displacement

models.title: Insulation resistance scale
models.modelBoundary: Isolated low-voltage steady DC measurement; the result does not certify high-voltage withstand
models.measurementChain: safe low-voltage source, calibrated current meter and dry-wet surface conditions

models.title: Thermal expansion compatibility
models.modelBoundary: Uniform heating and free polymer expansion; restrained preload changes require another model
models.measurementChain: model polymer and metal temperatures, lengths and clamp clearance

models.title: Cycle damage index
models.modelBoundary: Life values for each amplitude are supplied separately and damage accumulates linearly; sequence and interaction are omitted
models.measurementChain: synthetic load-amplitude histogram, cycle counts and amplitude-specific life curves

models.title: Stiffness degradation fraction
models.modelBoundary: Before-after load interval, temperature and test rate match; initial stiffness is nonzero
models.measurementChain: paired force-displacement curves, specimen temperature and repeat-test error

models.title: Isolation natural frequency
models.modelBoundary: Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped
models.measurementChain: model mass, static stiffness and damping-corrected free-decay frequency

models.title: Static support compression
models.modelBoundary: Gravity load is steady and support linear; dynamic load and travel-stop contact are excluded
models.measurementChain: model total weight, individual support heights and static loading-unloading

models.title: Damping ratio estimate
models.modelBoundary: Viscous damping and linear stiffness are known; Coulomb friction is not treated as constant viscous damping
models.measurementChain: model free-decay envelopes, several vibration amplitudes and frequency estimates

models.title: Frequency-ratio identification
models.modelBoundary: Excitation has one frequency and natural frequency uses the same operating condition
models.measurementChain: synthetic input-force spectrum, modal test and matched loading records

models.title: Force transmissibility estimate
models.modelBoundary: Harmonic force acts on the mass with a fixed base in linear steady state; not a formula for arbitrary base excitation
models.measurementChain: synchronized model input-force and base-reaction amplitudes and phases

models.title: Load per isolator
models.modelBoundary: Supports are symmetric, equally stiff and centered beneath the mass; static load only
models.measurementChain: individual model support force gauges, compression and center-of-mass location

models.title: Unequal-stiffness force share
models.modelBoundary: A rigid plate maintains identical support displacement without rotation; both supports remain in contact
models.measurementChain: separate support forces, shared displacement and plate rotation

models.title: Clearance reserve
models.modelBoundary: Dynamic motion is peak displacement toward the stop and shares a datum with static compression
models.measurementChain: model minimum clearance, static compression and synchronous dynamic peaks

models.title: Water added mass
models.modelBoundary: Water depth and area are uniform and water moves fully with the slab; flow and sloshing are excluded
models.measurementChain: model water-depth grid, total water volume and vibration frequency

models.title: Frequency reduction sensitivity
models.modelBoundary: Added mass is rigidly attached and stiffness unchanged; supports remain within linear travel
models.measurementChain: model masses, static heights and modal frequencies before and after added load

models.title: Corrugation passage frequency
models.modelBoundary: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded
models.measurementChain: synthetic profile-wavelength spectrum, synchronous speed and vibration spectrum

models.title: Spatial sampling interval
models.modelBoundary: Uniform temporal sampling and constant speed; missing samples and encoder slip are excluded
models.measurementChain: per-sample timestamps, distance encoder and adjacent-spacing statistics

models.title: Sinusoidal profile slope
models.modelBoundary: A small-amplitude single sinusoidal profile; the result is maximum slope magnitude
models.measurementChain: calibrated profilometer, spatial amplitude and wavelength, and numerical derivative

models.title: Geometric excitation acceleration
models.modelBoundary: A particle perfectly follows sinusoidal geometry; actual wheel acceleration with contact filtering is not represented
models.measurementChain: raw sinusoidal profile, ideal derivatives and synthetic contact-filtered signal

models.title: Grinding removal volume
models.modelBoundary: Removal depth and width are uniform along length; side removal and local excess are excluded
models.measurementChain: registered before-after section scans, effective width and segment length

models.title: Remaining wear allowance
models.modelBoundary: Initial allowance, wear and correction depth share one section direction and datum
models.measurementChain: repeated scans of the same section, removal records and datum registration

models.title: Band-amplitude reduction
models.modelBoundary: Matched frequency band, window and amplitude definition; negative decibels indicate reduced amplitude
models.measurementChain: registered before-after raw profiles, spectrum settings and amplitude ratio

models.title: Grinding frictional heat scale
models.modelBoundary: Constant tangential force and sliding speed; the result is total contact work, not heat wholly entering the rail
models.measurementChain: synthetic tangential force, relative sliding speed and heat partition among bodies

models.title: Corrugation regrowth rate
models.modelBoundary: Mean growth applies over the specified gross-tonnage interval; long-term linear growth is not assumed
models.measurementChain: registered corrugation amplitudes, cumulative gross tonnage and rolling-stock records

models.title: Profile RMS
models.modelBoundary: Three equally weighted points with unrelated datum offset removed; spatial phase is not retained
models.measurementChain: raw point elevations, chainage index and detrending rules

models.title: Sampling spatial resolution
models.modelBoundary: Speed and acquisition rate are constant; point spacing is not the full system's spatial resolving power
models.measurementChain: common-clock timestamps, speed and chainage for every sample

models.title: Minimum unaliased wavelength
models.modelBoundary: Uniform sampling and a band-limited signal; twice the spacing is a theoretical boundary, not guaranteed accurate reconstruction
models.measurementChain: synthetic multi-wavelength signals, anti-alias filtering and before-after spectra

models.title: Latency position error
models.modelBoundary: Speed is constant during known latency; localization bias itself is excluded
models.measurementChain: synthetic shared sensor events, endpoint timestamps and chainage

models.title: Inertial-bias displacement drift
models.modelBoundary: Constant acceleration bias with zero initial velocity and position errors
models.measurementChain: stationary bias readings, synthetic double integration and independent position reference

models.title: Gauge deviation calculation
models.modelBoundary: One measurement height and inner-face datum; the example reference gauge is not a universal requirement
models.measurementChain: calibrated gauge bar, measurement height and both rail-head profiles

models.title: Chord transfer gain
models.modelBoundary: Length is the complete symmetric chord with a midpoint sensor; input is a single sinusoidal profile
models.measurementChain: model profile with known amplitude and wavelength plus chord-end and midpoint coordinates

models.title: Local track twist
models.modelBoundary: Endpoint cant difference is divided by one defined base; twist over other bases is not represented
models.measurementChain: endpoint cant on one datum, base length and sign-convention markers

models.title: Outlier fraction
models.modelBoundary: Outlier rule and sample window are fixed; the ratio does not distinguish sensor faults from real defects
models.measurementChain: unaltered raw signals, labeling rules and repeat-pass records

models.title: Repeat-pass difference
models.modelBoundary: Passes are registered to the same chainage and direction under comparable conditions
models.measurementChain: fixed-landmark registration, correlation displacement and registered residuals

models.title: Detection recall
models.modelBoundary: The truth set is complete and event-matching rule fixed; the result is sample recall
models.measurementChain: blinded truth table, event-by-event decisions and missed-event list

models.title: Normal echo depth
models.modelBoundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector
models.measurementChain: known-thickness teaching block, time-zero calibration and full echo waveform

models.title: Oblique sound path
models.modelBoundary: Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated
models.measurementChain: model refracted angle, block-reflector depth and path-time echo

models.title: Horizontal reflector offset
models.modelBoundary: Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign
models.measurementChain: fixed probe coordinates, orientation markers and known reflector position

models.title: Frequency-wavelength conversion
models.modelBoundary: Speed and frequency describe the same wave mode; dispersion and broadband effects are omitted
models.measurementChain: known material wave speed, transmit-receive spectra and wave-mode labels

models.title: Echo-amplitude decibel comparison
models.modelBoundary: Amplitudes use the same receive chain with nonzero reference; amplitude rather than energy is compared
models.measurementChain: reference reflector, gain log and unsaturated raw echoes

models.title: Attenuation compensation scale
models.modelBoundary: Attenuation coefficient is constant and path is the total traveled distance; geometric spreading is separate
models.measurementChain: reference reflectors at several paths, equal-gain echoes and propagation-path diagram

models.title: Ultrasonic scan spacing
models.modelBoundary: Scan speed and effective pulse-acquisition rate are fixed; missed triggers and beam width are excluded
models.measurementChain: per-pulse timestamps, encoder positions and successful echo-acquisition counts

models.title: Dead-zone fraction
models.modelBoundary: Dead zone and total inspected extent share one direction; the fraction is not defect risk
models.measurementChain: artificial reflectors at different near-surface depths and beam configuration

models.title: Coupling signal ratio
models.modelBoundary: Baseline and current echoes share geometry, gain and material; the ratio is not independent coupling truth
models.measurementChain: backwall echoes, surface-condition images and another reference reflector

models.title: Blind-test miss fraction
models.modelBoundary: All true-defect samples are included with fixed decision rules; no universal detection rate is inferred
models.measurementChain: blinded sample codes, known-reflector inventory and specimen-level reports

models.title: Simply supported midspan moment
models.modelBoundary: One central point load, ideal simple supports and quasistatic response; actual ballast support distribution is not represented
models.measurementChain: scaled-beam support positions, load cell and midspan strain

models.title: Sleeper bending stress
models.modelBoundary: An uncracked elastic section with known section modulus; extreme-fibre stress only
models.measurementChain: model section dimensions, curvature strain and crack-initiation observation

models.title: Mean prestress compression
models.modelBoundary: Prestress is the effective value after losses and compression uniform; eccentric moment is separate
models.measurementChain: synthetic effective prestress, section area and symmetric axial strains

models.title: Prestress eccentric moment
models.modelBoundary: The prestress line has the stated centroidal offset; only bending about a transverse axis is included
models.measurementChain: model tendon positions, effective tension and section sign convention

models.title: Elastic deflection check
models.modelBoundary: Uniform simply supported beam under a central load, small deflection and negligible shear deformation
models.measurementChain: midspan displacement gauge, settlement of both supports and synchronized load

models.title: Rail-seat contact pressure
models.modelBoundary: Contact resultant and effective area are simultaneous; only mean pressure is calculated
models.measurementChain: model contact imprint, zonal pressures and total load

models.title: Crack-opening change
